description: This file defines a Go package 'dbus' with an 'encoder' struct and methods for encoding values into the D-Bus wire format, including handling various data types, alignment, and serialization logic.

classes.name: encoder
classes.description: A struct responsible for encoding values into the D-Bus wire format, managing output writer, file descriptors, byte order, and current position.

methods.name: newEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new encoder with specified output writer, byte order, and file descriptors.

methods.name: newEncoderAtOffset
methods.description: Creates a new encoder with specified output, offset, byte order, and file descriptors, initializing position for alignment.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns the output to a multiple of n bytes, writing padding as needed.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Calculates the number of padding bytes needed for alignment based on current position and offset.

methods.name: binwrite
methods.description: Writes a value to the output in binary form, panicking on error.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes multiple values into the D-Bus wire format, handling errors via panic.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Recursively encodes a reflect.Value into the wire format, handling various data types and nesting, panicking on errors.
